summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Optowire Angular 21 SSR catalog app (catalog-proxy-fix deployment). All 8 required features pass. Backend proxy correctly returns JSON (no Brotli), categories API filtered to 4 allowed IDs, sliders API returns real image paths, products total = 1138. Desktop mega-menu opens on hover showing 4 categories. Slider shows real product images. Mobile hamburger opens menu with Products accordion showing 4 categories.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: /health (root path without /api prefix) returns empty body in K8s preview env (likely served by nginx). /api/health returns correct JSON. Not a blocking issue.
NOTE: Products API POST /web/product/explore returns HTTP 201 (not 200) - external API behavior, proxy passes it through correctly.

NOTE: Category service filters all 6 API categories down to 4 allowed IDs (1, 91, 188, 212). The ALLOWED_CATEGORY_IDS set correctly excludes Electronic Devices (228) and Tools (154). This is consistent with the UI showing exactly 4 categories.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App at catalog-proxy-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend proxy at /api/ext/** forces Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate (no Brotli). Categories: 4 filtered (telecom, network-equipment, security-systems, iot). Sliders: /api/ext/web/sliders (plural). Products: POST /api/ext/web/product/explore returns 201. Desktop mega-menu: data-testid=nav-products-wrapper (hover), mega-menu, mega-cat-[slug]. Mobile: data-testid=mobile-menu-btn, mobile-menu, mobile-products-btn, mobile-products-dropdown, mobile-cat-[id].
